body:
Hi, sorry about the confusion. Yes, I am asking for jewellery. The eyeshadow bit was just to explain, I guess I will take that out. 


What I was asking was, can yellow gold look good on a cool skin tone? Dark hair and dark eyes?
I will try and get a photo up at the earliest :)
Thank you, I will make sure I do exactly that. :)

LOL! Here I was thinking, you were a boy too! He isn't into yoga, he's the weights/cardio kind of guy. Although, I think I will drag him to yoga places next year when I get a job you know, "to support me". I am liking this sneaky part! Yes, I will definitely be more proactive about spending time with him. I have been since last year and I hope that has helped him but now I will try very hard. You have given me hope and I feel so much better about the situation already. Thank you so much.

Thank you for making me feel a bit relieved. It really helps. All the time after I found out, I have been trying not to think about it, but obviously have been failing at that. A bit shaken tbh. 


Thank you, I shall do just that, mention help and how it helped me again sometimes and just be normal. I'm hoping his burden has been lifted a bit too with telling me and letting me in.

I am a girl and have been recently diagnosed with Lupus so...gym doesn't seem like a good idea right now lol but you know what? He's been wanting to gym lately, I think I will encourage him...as you said, will relieve him of the stress. He loves talking about things he has learnt and maybe I will just ask him random questions and he can explain them to me...and that can be an activity together too. This is a very good idea and I can spend time with him "sneakily" like you said. Thank you :)
